answer: Gross emissions cover HEINEKEN's total carbon footprint, while SBTi emissions cover the approved target boundary and activities HEINEKEN can influence. The SBTi boundary excludes less than 5% of Scope 1 and 2, primarily CH4, N2O and refrigerants, and less than 10% of Scope 3, primarily selected agricultural emissions, capital goods, specified logistics, commercial merchandise, spare parts, downstream transport and distribution, home cooling, franchises and investments.
subject: Heineken N.V.
scope_boundary: gross total footprint versus approved SBTi target boundary

evidence.quote: Gross GHG emissions reflect all emissions across our total carbon footprint. SBTi GHG emissions cover emissions within our approved SBTi target boundary ... excludes less than 5% of Scope 1 and 2 ... and less than 10% of Scope 3 ...
